lifeSpan: .input {$rule :string} .input {$unit :string} .input {$count :integer} .match $unit days {{a life of {$count} days}} months {{a life of {$count} months}} * {{a life of {$count} years}}
lifeClass: .input {$rule :string} .input {$class :string} .match $class balarishta {{death in infancy}} yogarishta {{an evil from a yoga}} short {{a short life}} medium {{a medium life}} long {{a long life}} divine {{a super-natural life}} * {{an illimitable life}}
participants: .input {$rule :string} .input {$count :integer} .match $count one {{{$grahas :list type=and} takes part}} * {{{$grahas :list type=and} take part}}
